updates.title: Safety Zone; Monongahela River, Pittsburgh, PA
updates.summary: The Coast Guard is establishing a temporary safety zone for navigable waters on the Monongahela River from Mile Marker 15 to Mile Marker 16. This safety zone is necessary to protect personnel and vessels from potential hazards on navigable waters during an operation to install aerial transverse wirelines. updates.title: Hardwood and Decorative Plywood From the People's Republic of China, Indonesia, and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam: Countervailing Duty Orders

updates.title: Respirable Crystalline Silica and Respiratory Protection
updates.summary: The Mine Safety and Health Administration (MSHA) is correcting an error in the "Respirable Crystalline Silica and Respiratory Protection" proposed rule that was published in the Federal Register on November 12, 2026. The proposed rule clarifies and modifies provisions of MSHA's respirable crystalline silica and respiratory protection standards.

updates.title: Publication of the Tier 2 Tax Rates
updates.summary: Publication of the tier 2 tax rates for calendar year 2027 as required by section 3241(d) of the Internal Revenue Code. Tier 2 taxes on railroad employees, employers, and employee representatives are one source of funding for benefits under the Railroad Retirement Act.
